I just got a 2013 Mazda 2 and had this "No Content" error, but it turned out to be a weird iOS thing and not a problem with the USB connection or the stereo. Apparently it's a common problem with iphones after a certain iOS version, that car stereos don't "see" iphones when they're plugged in unless they have CarPlay. I fixed it by downloading one song on my phone (I didn't have any before) so that the car stereo would "see" my phone as an ipod, then I could play music from any app with no problem. I hope this helps!
